title: Is there an opening for Nvidia's competitors, now that Jensen Huang is out?
description:
Christopher Intagliata

NPR's Scott Detrow talks with Dylan Patel of the AI and semiconductor research firm SemiAnalysis about Jensen Huang's departure from Nvidia, and whether it opens up the field for Nvidia's competitors.
